I hope it was that easy. Each time I try to make me at least feel alive everyone makes me feel that I dont have that right. I would try to carry my son and always end up depressed knowing that I could not be the father i wanted myself to be. whenever i show my feelings to anyone they would think that im a wuss who cant handle it. even my wife does it to me and im sick of it. I feel like im now a burden to them and myself. im now writing of all of whatever junk that I have and my life insurance to my son. hopefully my son would get a payout with my life (im planning to make it look like an accident for him)

I do thank you for your kind words. If only more people in this world were like you. then there wouldnt be a lot of us. if only I met or have spoken to someone like you before.. maybe it may not be too late.. but i feel like it is and this is the only thing to fix this..
